title: Span links on Unity Catalog traces: qualify link targets with the source trace's UC location and skip cross-location links
answers: Why do span links disappear from traces stored in Unity Catalog, and how are they kept now?
How does add_link handle a link whose trace ID is a bare hex ID or a tr- ID on a UC trace?
Where are cross-location span links rejected, and why does a link to another catalog.schema get skipped?
Does an archived or OTLP-round-tripped UC span still keep its links with the catalog.schema location?
body:
Path: Span link handling for traces logged with a Unity Catalog location (trace IDs of the form trace:/catalog.schema/...). It covers links passed to span.add_link on a live span, links seeded from native OpenTelemetry links at construction, and links converted to and from OTLP protos in mlflow/entities/span.py:Span.from_otel_proto and Span.to_otel_proto.
Rule: Use mlflow/entities/span.py:_normalize_link_trace_id as the single place that decides a link target. A bare or tr- target is qualified with the source trace's UC location (construct_trace_id_v4). A target that already carries a location is kept only if it matches the source location; otherwise it returns None and LiveSpan.add_link logs a 'Cross-location span links are not supported' warning and skips the link. Native OTel links go through mlflow/entities/span.py:_link_from_otel_link, so they are normalized the same way.
Rule: For archived spans restored with preserve_request_id, normalize links against the effective preserved request ID (not the generated tr-... mlflow_trace_id) in Span.from_otel_proto, or the UC location is stripped on round trip.
Symptom: Links on Unity Catalog traces were silently dropped at span construction and in add_link, with a 'Span links are not currently supported for Unity Catalog traces' warning, so UI and SDK readers saw no links on UC-backed traces.
Constraints: Applies only to UC (V4) trace IDs. Non-UC traces keep the plain tr-<hex> behaviour. Cross-location links are intentionally skipped so traces from different UC locations are never conflated; do not 'fix' that skip by storing the foreign ID.
applies: Any change touching span links, add_link, or OTLP conversion of spans whose trace ID starts with trace:/ (Unity Catalog trace location).
says: Span links are missing or dropped on traces stored in Unity Catalog.
Trace links between spans disappear when viewing traces logged to Unity Catalog destinations.
Warning message stating span links are not supported appears on Unity Catalog traces.
Archived traces stored in catalog schemas lose their span links after round trip export.
Linking spans across different catalog schemas is skipped with an unsupported location warning.
search: For traces logged with a Unity Catalog location (trace IDs starting with trace:/catalog.schema/...), mlflow/entities/span.py:_normalize_link_trace_id qualifies bare hex or tr- link targets with the source trace's UC location using construct_trace_id_v4. Targets carrying an existing location are retained only if matching the source location, while cross-location links return None, causing LiveSpan.add_link to log a warning and skip the link. In Span.from_otel_proto, restored archived spans with preserve_request_id must normalize links against the effective preserved request ID to prevent stripping UC locations on round trip. This applies exclusively to UC (V4) trace IDs while cross-location links remain skipped to prevent conflation.
